name: gender_agreement_es
description: Check gender and number agreement in Spanish noun phrases (determiner, adjectives, noun, and an adjective after ser or estar) and suggest the corrected form. A heuristic: noun gender comes from a bundled lexicon of exceptions (el día, la mano, el problema and the Greek -ma nouns, la flor, el análisis, common-gender and either-gender nouns) or from the ending (-ción, -dad, -o, -a…), and it applies RAE's rule for feminine nouns beginning with stressed a or ha: el agua fría, las aguas, esta agua, mucha hambre, la fría agua.

text.description: Noun phrases or short sentences in Spanish

catalog.source: original; rules from the RAE Diccionario panhispánico de dudas (entries el, un, este, agua, hambre) and the Nueva gramática de la lengua española, ch. 2 (género) and 3 (número)
